ctaHeading: Albion's HVAC Experts Are Here to Help
aboutText: Based in Albion, Specific Refrigeration & Mechanical Services (SRS) designs, builds, installs, and services refrigeration and HVAC systems. We cater to commercial, industrial, sport & recreation, residential, and food processing sectors throughout Melbourne, regional Victoria, and Australia-wide. Our team delivers reliable solutions for iconic public and private companies.
servicesText: SRS provides end-to-end refrigeration and HVAC solutions, including system design, installation, and maintenance. We specialise in projects for commercial buildings, industrial facilities, sports complexes, and residential properties across Albion and beyond.
